alt: Painted night scene of an iron footbridge lit by small lamps, crossing a still river from an old brick quarter to glass towers, under a full moon.
Woodblock print of a grey heron standing still among reeds at sunrise, its reflection unbroken, mountains on the horizon.
Watercolor of a stone sundial in a dewy garden at sunrise, a cottage and a lake beyond.
Screenprint poster of a jeweler's loupe beside an open pocket watch showing its gears, under a work lamp.
Blueprint drawing of a sorting hall where parcels ride conveyor belts between stations and wait on buffer shelves.
Papercut diorama of a single campfire on one side of a river valley and a village ringed with many campfires on the other.
Leaded stained-glass window backlit by low sun: a band of ruby flowers and amber lattice on cobalt, with two small hinged panes swung open and one shut.
Tilt-shift miniature valley at sunset where a new railway track runs beside the old one, a small locomotive on each, work lamps along the line.

theme: The back of the work matters too
alt: Two embroidery hoops on linen: one holds a floral design only outlined in thread, the other the same flowers fully stitched in rust, indigo and sage.
Charcoal and chalk drawing on grey paper of an arched stone bridge over a river, its construction lines still visible around it.
Painted night scene of a climber high on a granite wall, clipped into a line of glowing anchors, with a belayer below and a lit valley far beneath.

theme: Looks for the evidence that would prove him wrong
alt: Woodblock print of a stone pillar standing in curling waves off a fishing village, waterlines marked on its side.
Watercolor of a seedling growing from the top of a stack of books on a sunny windowsill above a hill town.
Screenprint poster of a giant ratchet gear and pawl on a hilltop against a rising sun over a river valley.
Blueprint drawing of two railway lines of different gauges joined by a precise set of switches at a station.
Papercut diorama of a pruned bonsai on a low table, the cut branches and shears laid beside it, a lake beyond.
A pair of stained-glass doors in an old stone wall, one propped open onto a sunlit garden, casting coloured light on the flagstones.
Miniature workshop counter handing out identical red toolboxes to a line of small clay figures on a cobbled street.
A worn indigo cloth on linen with a frayed spot mended by a patch of white sashiko stitches, a needle and white thread beside it.
Sketchbook spread with a faint, half-erased outline of a cottage on the left and a finished charcoal cottage and tree on the right.
Painted night scene of a home library with shelves of technical books and manga, a leather armchair, a cat asleep on a cushion, and a desk lamp by a window over a city.
Woodblock print of a straw scarecrow in a wide hat standing upright in a rice field while rain and wind bend the stalks.
Watercolor of an oak sapling growing from cracked stone steps, the hills behind passing from spring to winter.
Screenprint poster of a long lever on a small fulcrum lifting a huge boulder on a hilltop.
Blueprint cutaway of a beehive, bees streaming in and out past thousands of orderly hexagonal cells.
Papercut diorama of a mosaic of a sunrise over hills taking shape on a wall, a tray of new tiles waiting.

theme: Frame the problem before the options
alt: An empty leaded frame laid out on a glazier's bench, with stacks of cobalt, ruby, amber and green glass waiting beside it.
Miniature country lane lined with little mailboxes on posts, cottages and felt trees behind, nobody waiting.

theme: Unpicking is part of the craft
alt: A line of stitches on linen ending where it was unpicked, loose rust thread curling beside a seam ripper and a spool.

theme: Work from the big shapes down
alt: Charcoal skyline blocked in as plain boxes and cylinders, with only one tower in the middle drawn out with windows.
Painted aerial view of a city at night, its avenues glowing like circuit traces around an obelisk, with a wide river along one edge.
Woodblock print of a cedar forest where a path splits three ways, each lit by a stone lantern, toward three hills.
Watercolor of one tall tree on a hillside catching the first light, a misty forest in the valley below.

theme: Every position needs a written reason
alt: Screenprint poster of an open logbook and an oil lamp by a window, a lighthouse sweeping its beam over the sea at dusk.

theme: Modernizing infrastructure without stopping the flow
alt: Blueprint drawing of an old stone aqueduct with a new pipeline running alongside it across a valley.
Papercut diorama of climbing roses at different heights, each guided up its own wooden trellis.
Stained-glass panel of ruby diamonds and scrollwork where one cracked pane has been rejoined with a bright new lead line.
Miniature rocky island at dusk with two keepers' cottages side by side beneath a lit lighthouse, small boats moored below.
An indigo thread and a rust thread stretched across linen, joined in the middle by one small neat knot.
Charcoal still life of a jug, a folded cloth, a bowl and two pears, all lit from the left with every shadow falling right.
Painted night scene inside a greenhouse, rows of seedlings under hanging lamps, taller plants leaning over the newest shoots, a moonlit lake beyond the glass.
Woodblock print of a blank open logbook and a brass compass on a ship's deck, great waves and a distant mountain beyond.

theme: A career is a lifetime, not a ladder
alt: Watercolor of a footpath winding through spring, summer, autumn and winter hills, a wooden ladder lying unused in the grass.
Screenprint poster of a garden wall with a wide-open wooden door onto sunny fields beside a chained iron gate.
Blueprint drawing of weather instruments and an observatory on a ridge, a storm rolling in over the valley.
Papercut diorama of five small sailboats with different colored sails crossing a bay toward a lighthouse harbor.

theme: Make the right path the easy path
alt: Stained-glass garden where a wide amber path runs straight toward the light between dim blue side paths and red flowers.
Miniature street of plain houses at dusk, one upstairs window softly lit, felt trees and streetlamps along the road.
A wooden hoop holding linen taut around a sage-green stitched motif while the cloth outside it lies rumpled.
Pale chalk drawing of a sunlit street of whitewashed houses with one deep black open doorway at the centre.
Painted night scene of an empty concert stage, orchestra instruments resting at lit music stands around an empty conductor's podium.

theme: Ownership goes to the people closest to the work
alt: Woodblock print of one hand passing a glowing baton to another above a winding road and a rising sun.
Watercolor of a vegetable garden at sunrise where a drip line waters every row, not only the plant in the light.

theme: When unsure, he stops instead of guessing
alt: Screenprint poster of a railway signal set to stop beside an empty track running to a sunset horizon.
Blueprint drawing of a fire station at rest, the engine facing the open doors and hose reels coiled and ready.
Papercut diorama of a broad umbrella pine whose wide canopy shades a whole meadow of wildflowers.
Stained-glass bell tower against a cobalt sky, a single hand holding the bell's rope, between pale diamond-paned panels.

theme: Onboarding is the first product a new hire uses
alt: Miniature town entrance with a picture map on a wooden stand and a row of small lanterns lining the path into town.
A needle threaded with ochre silk resting on linen beside a neat row of five wooden spools in other colours.
A band of dense dark charcoal across a sketchbook out of which a pale tree on a hill appears, drawn only by the shading around it.
Painted scene of a single paper lantern lighting brass gears inside a vast, dark clockwork hall.

theme: Conway's law as a planning tool
alt: Woodblock print of rice terraces on a mountainside, water flowing from one terrace to the next, a farmhouse at the top.
Watercolor of pantry shelves of jars of saved seeds and beans, a freshly turned garden outside the window.
Screenprint poster of a paper airplane held in a wind tunnel, smoke streamlines flowing around it toward a big fan.
Blueprint drawing of an open round vault door with its ring of steel bolts and gears, an orderly room behind it.
Papercut diorama of a sunflower field on rolling hills, every flower turned toward the same sun.
A round rose window in a pale wall, glowing gold at its centre and darkening ring by ring to deep violet at the rim.
Miniature town at dusk where a small crane lifts an empty shed off a cleared lot while every house around it stays lit.
A long leafy border on linen, the left half stitched in colour and the right half still a white outline, a paper pattern pinned above.

theme: The draft is not the decision
alt: Crumpled charcoal sketches on a dark table beside one clean finished drawing of a lighthouse on a headland and a stick of charcoal.
Painted night landscape where a glowing heartbeat line in the sky turns into a power line that runs to a village of lit stone houses.
Woodblock print of tall cardón cacti beside a mountain road winding through fog at dusk, a pale moon above.

theme: Write the memo before the meeting
alt: Watercolor of a desk with a sealed letter under a stone and a fountain pen, an empty meeting table through the doorway.
Screenprint poster of a bandoneon on a café chair on a cobblestone corner, streetlamps and balconies along a tree-lined avenue.
Blueprint cross-section of a canal lock, a boat waiting in the chamber between two gates holding the water at two levels.
Papercut diorama of a crossroads signpost with one arrow painted ochre, carts already moving down that road.
Stained-glass figure in a green hooded cloak holding a lantern up toward a dark blue corner, its glow in rings of yellow glass.
Two miniature villages, red roofs and blue roofs, on either side of a river, meeting at a stone bridge with a small booth.
A long embroidered vine across linen, every leaf the same small green stitch repeated along an ochre stem.
A small charcoal drawing of a harbour with moored boats, kept to the centre of a sketchbook spread with wide empty paper around it.
Painted river at dusk turning to night, paper boats on stepping stones passing a small light from one boat to the next.
Woodblock print of a rider in a wide hat and a horse galloping as one across a windswept plain.
Watercolor of an old stone tower beside a taller new tower in scaffolding, above a harbor town at sunrise.

theme: The peer-to-peer web survived as paint
alt: Screenprint poster of houses on rolling hills at twilight, each with a lantern, linked by strings of light.
Blueprint drawing of a laboratory balance beside a row of calibration weights from largest to smallest.
Papercut diorama of a globe half in day and half in night, glowing threads linking cities around it.
Stained-glass panel of an older hand and a younger hand together placing one ruby triangle among blue and amber glass.
Miniature stadium with two tiny clay runners on a red track at the moment one passes the baton to the other.
A tight woven band across linen in indigo, ochre, sage and rust threads, loose ends fringing both edges.

theme: Shadows show where the risk is
alt: Light charcoal sketch of a trestle footbridge over a ravine, the darkest shading gathered under a single support.
Painted scene of a lone tree with a lantern on a calm island, while a storm drawn in swirling ink lines circles at a distance.
Woodblock print of a go game left mid-play on a veranda, two empty cushions, maple leaves drifted across the board.

theme: Bad news does not age well
alt: Watercolor of a lantern set beside a small crack in an old stone dam, a calm green valley below.

theme: Change failure rate is a risk budget
alt: Screenprint poster of a tightrope between two striped towers with a safety net below holding three juggling balls.
Blueprint exploded view of dovetail, mortise and tenon and finger joints, each shown apart and then fitted together.
Papercut diorama of a hot-air balloon floating level above a sea of dark storm clouds at sunrise.
Stained-glass night scene: a closed iron garden gate between stone pillars, a small lamp glowing amber beside it under a blue sky.
Miniature patchwork of fenced fields in different crop colours, joined by paths and gates, with small red barns.

theme: Slow is smooth, smooth is fast
alt: One even running stitch in rust thread crossing the whole width of the linen, the needle still at its end.
A lone windswept tree on a low hill drawn in a few bold charcoal strokes on wide empty grey paper.

theme: Cognitive debt is the quiet one
alt: Woodblock print of a snowy lake under a full moon, fine cracks spreading quietly across the ice.

theme: A rule nothing checks is a wish
alt: Watercolor of dandelion seeds blowing across a meadow beside a garden gate held shut by a latch and padlock.
Screenprint poster of a ship in dry dock under floodlights, scaffolding along its hull, cranes and a harbor beyond.
Blueprint drawing of a carrier pigeon with a sealed capsule flying a dotted path from one loft to another over rooftops.
Papercut diorama of bowls and a vase mended with gold seams on a shelf, a garden through a round window.
Woodblock print of two stone lanterns on opposite banks of a river at dusk, their light reaching across the water.
Watercolor of a timber house frame standing on a finished stone foundation, a village and lake at sunrise beyond.
Screenprint poster of a lantern on the ground lighting the one gap in a long wooden fence across a misty meadow.
Blueprint cutaway of a building threaded with pneumatic tubes, capsules travelling between floors.
Papercut diorama of a windmill in cutaway, a large and a small gear meshing to turn the millstone among wheat fields.
